intro.title: Black keys come in groups
intro.text: Look at the black keys: they repeat in groups of two and three. That pattern is your map of the whole keyboard.

intro.title: C sits left of the two
intro.text: Every white key just left of a two-black-key group is a C. They repeat every 12 keys: each one is an octave apart.

intro.title: Middle C
intro.text: Middle C (C4) is the C nearest the middle of your keyboard. On your 61-key Casio it's the 3rd C from the left. The number after the letter tells you which octave.

intro.title: How this drill works
intro.text: A C appears on screen. Find it on your keyboard and play it. No rhythm, no rush: only your first answer counts.
